pages.sourceObservation: Hero-talent choices, copy-build buttons and import codes coexist with explanatory prose. Existing French player glossary covers 'talent builds' and 'funnel damage'; actual ID localization and copy-widget behavior require browser verification.

Executable macro examples contain #showtooltip, /use, /stopmacro and /petattack. These must be preserved verbatim, including conditionals and spell names inside code; existing glossary handles 'mouseover macros' only in prose. Cross-check with Enhancement Shaman and Vengeance Demon Hunter macro guides.
Leveling talent order mixes official linked spell names with prose. 'chain pulling' also occurs in Arms Warrior leveling; avoid a bare phrase override until grammatical context is handled generally.

crossPageFindings: The indexed English prose and localized spell links on /fr/ and other localized Wowhead views are separate language signals; do not infer source prose language from URL locale.
The macro code/opaque import content protection problem recurs across Hunter, Shaman and Demon Hunter guides, but the browser DOM and packaged engine cannot be verified from indexed excerpts alone.
